description: This file implements a WebSocket connection manager class using FastAPI, handling real-time WebSocket connections, including connect, disconnect, message broadcasting, and user-specific messaging for a sports live-stream platform.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for real-time event updates, including connection handling and message broadcasting.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager with data structures to track active connections, user connections, and metadata.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, event_id: str, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Accepts a new WebSocket connection, stores connection info, and sends a confirmation message.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from tracking data structures and logs disconnection.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any], websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific WebSocket client.

methods.name: broadcast_to_event(self, message: Dict[str, Any], event_id: str)
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket connections associated with a specific event.

methods.name: broadcast_emoji_reaction(self, event_id: str, emoji_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts emoji reactions to all clients connected to an event.

methods.name: broadcast_match_update(self, event_id: str, match_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts match updates to all clients connected to an event.

methods.name: send_to_user(self, user_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific user based on user ID.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active WebSocket connections for a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections.

methods.name: List[str] get_active_events(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of event IDs with active WebSocket connections.
